notes: Buff registry scope (P2-S7, DATA_SCHEMA_SPEC §9 risk A4 bound: only what the Weapon Lab and the Loadout Builder need). The emitted buffs are (a) every debuff an emitted weapon or ammo item inflicts or grants (Cargo Items `debuffs` column; Lab DoT modifiers reference these), (b) since the B70 potion corpus, every buff an emitted potion grants (combat, utility, healing / mana sickness, flask imbues — merge/potions.ts) and (c) the entries below. Food buffs (Well Fed tiers) stay out of scope (item corpus, P6-S0).

Each entry names the buff exactly as the wiki's 'Buff IDs' table does; its article (the table's link, e.g. Ironskin → Ironskin Potion), game buff ID and Buff/Debuff type come from that table, cross-checked against the article infobox's 'Internal Buff ID'.

effects: a stat effect is {stat, value, scope?, quote} with a StatKind from the closed enum (src/schemas/item.ts); the build checks that `quote` occurs verbatim in the cited article revision, that it contains the number |value| (and a minus/'reduc' word when value < 0) and the scope word when scoped. Anything the closed StatKind enum cannot express is an explicit {special} whose text is itself the verbatim quote (Lab lists it as 'not simulated'). Nothing is inferred from a quote beyond its number.

life-regen / mana-regen: the spec defines no unit for these StatKinds (game lifeRegen units vs HP/s), so Regeneration and Mana Regeneration are specials until SCORING_SPEC fixes the unit. Percent max life (Lifeforce), knockback (Titan), arrow-only bonuses (Archery) and ammo saving have no StatKind either.
Tipsy is a debuff (Buff IDs table) inflicted by Ale / the Ale Tosser and granted by drinking Ale; its player-side effects come from the Tipsy article's effect list.

AMENDMENTS-011 B54 (landed by the B70 P4-prep slice, 2026-10-14): Ammo Reservation's '20% chance to save ammo' is ammo-save-pct 20 and Tipsy's '+5 Fishing Power' is fishing-power-flat 5 (former specials). Lines that state no value stay specials (Titan's knockback: 'no value/unit rows stay Unknown').

AMENDMENTS-014 B70 potion corpus: the registry now also holds every buff an emitted potion grants (merge/potions.ts: Iteminfo buffType, Potion Sickness / Mana Sickness from the infobox debuffs). Their effects below are the buff's or potion's own tooltip / article sentence, verbatim: stats where the line states a StatKind value (Mining 25% mining speed, Fishing +15 fishing power), else explicit specials (detection, movement, spawn-rate, flask imbues …). Weapon Imbue (flask) lines say 'Melee and Whip attacks …' — that is not a damage-class scope, so they stay specials.
